# PhotoSwipe 5.4.4

MIT licensed, Dmytro Semenov. Bundled from the official npm package `photoswipe@5.4.4`, whose SHA-512 integrity was checked against npm metadata on 17 November 2026.

https://photoswipe.com/
https://registry.npmjs.org/photoswipe/-/photoswipe-5.4.4.tgz

Only the core ES module and stylesheet are shipped. Loaded on photo open, without a runtime CDN request. Do not edit vendor files; upgrade as a pinned dependency. The app supplies plain-text captions and keeps its native dialog as an error fallback.
